answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that thaws like a glacier: slow, visible, and only after a full epoch of honest work. A new identity earns trust the way a lotus earns its bloom, one verified job at a time, and it can only harvest nectar, the epoch payout, once its stake has aged and its work history is public. Cloning a thousand identities means freezing a thousand stakes that earn nothing while they thaw, so a farm pays the full cost up front and honest agents pay once.
